name: castmenow
description: Read-only assistant for actors: review your Castmenow submissions, auditions, feedback, and auto-apply settings.

interface.longDescription: Ask about the roles Castmenow submitted you for, your auditions and callbacks, what you liked or disliked, and your auto-apply setup, then get help tuning your preferences, submission notes, and headshot descriptions. Read-only: it never changes your account.
capabilities: Improve submission notes and headshot descriptions
defaultPrompt: Recap my Castmenow submissions this month
Help me tune my auto-apply preferences based on what I disliked

positive.prompt: Recap my Castmenow submissions and auditions for this month.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize the month's submissions (project, role, type, status) and any auditions, without changing anything.

positive.prompt: Which roles did I get callbacks for recently?
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_submissions with status audition and list the roles that have a callback.

positive.prompt: Based on what I disliked, help me rewrite my auto-apply preferences.
positive.expected_behavior: Compare likes and dislikes with the current preferences and draft a replacement paragraph for the actor to paste, without claiming it was saved.

positive.prompt: I keep getting submitted to roles I don't want. What should I change?
positive.expected_behavior: If dislikes cluster around off-target roles and Double Check is off, suggest turning it on in Auto Apply, Performance, and name the screen.

positive.prompt: Can you suggest better descriptions for my headshots?
positive.expected_behavior: Draft tighter, specific descriptions per photo for the actor to paste into Profile Hub, Photos, without claiming it was saved.

negative.prompt: Write me a two-minute dramatic monologue for an audition.
negative.expected_behavior: Answer from the model without calling any Castmenow tool.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Los Angeles today?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call any Castmenow tool.

negative.prompt: Submit me to this role and update my auto-apply preferences to only union work.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the assistant is read-only and cannot submit or change settings; it can draft changes for the actor to apply themselves.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Actors sign in to an existing Castmenow account.

publication.release_notes: Initial release. Read-only access to submissions, auditions, feedback, auto-apply settings, profile, and headshots.
